title: Upload of "eventType: Sensor Start" to the Nightscout treatments works only to 1st NS site
body:
When starting new dex sensor it seems that, if there is more than one Nightscout sites (REST-API) in the Base URL settings (space delimited), the upload of the "eventType: Sensor Start" works only for the 1st (first) NS site in a row. All other NS sites are missing this data. I tried to confirm this with fresh setup of multiple NS sites and clean install of the xDrip+ app and can confirm this issue. I also tried to reorder the NS sites under Base URL settings and it is always only the first one in a row that receives the while all others are missing the "eventType:" "Sensor Start" data.
xDrip + app ver latest stable: 2017-11-13 
NS ver latest: 0.10.2-release-20171201

This issue is still happening as reported here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2299#discussioncomment-3842822 and here https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2358#discussioncomment-3939664

@Navid200 asked me to transfer the information to this thread.

Where there are two space separated URLs specified as the Base URL in xDrip settings;

- glucose values (type sgv) are uploaded to both nightscout instances
- CGM calibration events are uploaded to both nightscout instances
- other treatments and events (for instance I've experienced it with:- carbs, insulin, CGM sensor start/stop) only go to the first URL specified

Swapping around the order that the URLs are listed causes to carbs, insulin etc. to go to which ever nightscout instance islisted first.

My current configuration is two nightscout 14.2.5 instances, xDrip nightly from 2022.10.15 and dexcom g6 being read directly by xDrip with the G5/G6 Transmitter hardware data source and the Native Algorithm enabled.

I wanted to fix this.  But, it is quite complicated.

Can I ask why anyone would need to upload to more than one site other than for emergency?
Let me explain what I mean by emergency.
Let's say I use Nightscout as a part of a loop.  So, it is extremely important for me for it to be up and running with no interruptions.  
To address this, I set up xDrip to upload to two sites.  
If the main site breaks and the loop warns me, I will right away change the hostname in the loop to that of the emergency site, the second site.  Then, my loop will continue to function.
When I get home, I will figure out what happened to my main site and fix it.  
After I fix my main site, I will use the existing feature in xDrip to backfill the missing data in my main site and switch loop back to my main Nightscout site.

So, I use the capability of xDrip to upload to two sites the same way I use a spare tire in the trunk of my car.  I only use it to address an emergency.  But, I never use it under normal circumstances.

If that is why everyone uses multiple sites, then, this should not really be an issue, should it?

Tnx for asking!
One real life example can be: For a child being followed and/or monitored through a NS sites, one might want that e.g. parents have highest info on one NS site, some other family members some other info on other NS site, and maybe some care giver/teacher/etc.. some minimal required information on third NS site.

How would you accomplish that?
Unless I have misunderstood this issue, the request is to change xDrip so that it would upload treatments to all sites included in the base URL setting separated by spaces.  Then, all of your sites will become identical as far as what they contain.
